properties.title: Model and strategy order must not alter exact minimax-regret output
properties.input_transform: Reverse model_ids and reverse strategy order; preserve all utilities by identity.
properties.invariant: best_utility_by_model, maximum_regret_by_strategy, selected_strategy and minimum_maximum_regret remain identical.
properties.claim_ceiling: Tests algorithmic invariants of the reference kernel only; no geological, physical or site-specific claim.

properties.title: Adding a constant utility offset to every strategy within each model preserves regret
properties.input_transform: For each model independently, add the same integer constant to all strategy utilities.
properties.invariant: All strategy regret values, selected strategy and minimum maximum regret remain identical.
properties.claim_ceiling: Tests algorithmic invariants of the reference kernel only; no geological, physical or site-specific claim.

properties.title: Ordering mandatory floors must not alter candidate eligibility
properties.input_transform: Permute required floor identifiers without changing any per-model GateResult.
properties.claim_ceiling: Tests algorithmic invariants of the reference kernel only; no geological, physical or site-specific claim.

properties.title: Adding an admissible model cannot reduce any strategy's maximum regret
properties.input_transform: Add one additional fully specified model and utility for every strategy.
properties.invariant: For every existing strategy, maximum regret over the expanded model set is greater than or equal to its prior maximum regret.
properties.claim_ceiling: Tests algorithmic invariants of the reference kernel only; no geological, physical or site-specific claim.

properties.title: A fixed pairwise ordering across all models is classified as invariant
properties.input_transform: Supply complete utility values for all strategies under multiple model families with the same pairwise ordering.
properties.invariant: classify_ranking_stability returns DecisionClass::Invariant; any pairwise ordering reversal or tie transition returns ModelSensitive.
properties.claim_ceiling: Tests algorithmic invariants of the reference kernel only; no geological, physical or site-specific claim.
